servicesPage.processLead: A proven five-phase framework — from first brief to repeatable playbook.

process.title: GTM Architecture
process.desc: We start by getting ruthlessly clear on who we're targeting, what problem we're solving, and how the offer lands against the competitive landscape. ICP definition, positioning, offer structure, and funnel map — locked before a single asset is written.

process.title: Pre-Launch Warmup
process.desc: Audience priming across email and organic channels — warming cold subscribers, building anticipation, and setting up the nurture sequences that qualify leads before the cart opens. No launch succeeds without a warm audience.

process.title: Multi-Channel Launch
process.desc: Coordinated execution across email, paid, and organic — timed to hit simultaneously and reinforce each touchpoint. Checkout optimization, urgency copy, and cart abandonment sequences fire in real time to maximize conversion at peak intent.

process.title: Post-Launch Nurture
process.desc: The launch ends — the revenue engine doesn't. Lifecycle sequences, retention flows, win-back campaigns, and lead recovery automation keep your audience engaged and your pipeline full between launches.

process.title: Optimization & Playbooks
process.desc: Post-mortem analysis against every KPI, UTM attribution audit, and a documented SOP library — so your next launch runs faster, tighter, and with predictable results. Strategy that compounds every cycle.

caseStudyPages.title: Mindset Mastery
caseStudyPages.sub: A full go-to-market build and high-ticket launch — from zero to sold out.
caseStudyPages.metricsDisclaimer: * Figures are representative and reflect the scope and nature of work delivered.
caseStudyPages.challengeLead: A high-ticket membership program with no funnel, no launch system, and no attribution.
challenge: The client had a compelling offer and a loyal audience — but no infrastructure to monetize either. There was no dedicated program site, no email sequence built for conversion, and no way to track where leads were coming from or why they converted.
Every launch was one-off, improvised, and impossible to repeat. The goal: build a repeatable revenue engine from scratch — one that could fill seats predictably and compound over time.
caseStudyPages.approachHeading: Built end to end. Owned top to bottom.
caseStudyPages.approachLead: Every asset, every automation, every data point — designed as a system, not a sprint.
approach: Program site + landing pages. Designed and built a conversion-optimized program site with dedicated landing pages per audience segment. Copy, structure, and hierarchy all calibrated for high-ticket intent.
Full launch email sequence. Wrote every email in the launch cadence — nurture, open-cart, urgency, and close. Engineered for segmentation so messaging matched where each lead was in the funnel.

Lead attribution + funnel ownership. Implemented UTM governance, built a KPI tracking dashboard, and wired up source attribution from first touch to closed seat. No more guessing where buyers came from.

Automations + lifecycle triggers. Set up behavioral automations for lead nurture, cart abandonment, and post-purchase onboarding. Every trigger had a purpose — reduce friction, increase conviction, advance the close.

15+ assets shipped. From opt-in copy and social proof callouts to email templates and confirmation sequences — every touchpoint was built with the same strategic intent: remove doubt and move buyers forward.
caseStudyPages.resultLead: From scattered one-off launches to a repeatable, predictable revenue architecture.
caseStudyPages.before: Broad messaging that spoke to everyone and converted no one. One-off launches with no documentation, no repeatable process, and no data trail. Attribution was guesswork — there was no way to know which channel, which message, or which moment drove the close.
caseStudyPages.after: Tightened segment narratives with copy engineered per buyer profile. A repeatable launch architecture — documented, templated, and scalable. Full attribution from first-touch to enrolled seat, with a KPI dashboard to prove ROI on every campaign going forward.
caseStudyPages.quote: Filled every seat — 100% conversion of high-ticket leads.
